text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: (...Oh? It seems rather lively outside—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Here it comes! Cheva-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! A slider?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: As expected of Cheva-chi, you're amazing, Cheva-chi~♪ I knew you'd catch it~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Don't throw in breaking balls out of nowhere... geez.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Fufu, nice catch. Your skills have improved even more.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, it's big sister's turn next~! Hmm, what kind of breaking ball should I throw~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Fufu. What truly close sisters...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: (Sisters, huh—)

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on! You are throwing far too hard!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Sorry, sorry! I just thought you'd be able to catch it, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Ryan's gotten even better at it. ............Must be nice...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ramonu-san! Um... w-what do you say?! Would you like to join us for once!

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Fufu, very well.

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Sister... C-Can I join too...—

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch! Ow ow... my legs...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: .... I ended up reminiscing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: —That day was warm just like today, wasn't it. The breeze was so... pleasant too—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: ............ Ah... Did I fall asleep...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Ardan. Turn around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Eh? S-Sister! Turn around, you say—?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Your hair. It is a mess.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Truly, you haven't changed at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Eh...? —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What, it's still only just past noon... ............Days really are so long...

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Ardan, turn around. I shall brush your hair.

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, eh! Sister is—?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...What is it? Why that dopey smile?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! It's just, well—...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking... this is fine just the way it is for us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home after wrapping up some work— I ran into Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Oh... fufu, thank you for your hard work so late into the evening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! Actually, I was meeting with my sister until just a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Truly, time flies by in the blink of an eye. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: D-Do I look that way? ............

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: —I was able to talk with my sister. About all kinds of fun things that have happened recently.
